pieces.title: TEST Your 2026 contractors: the 1099 threshold is now $2,000

content.hook: Paid a contractor $2,000 or more in 2026?
lines: For payments made in 2026, Form 1099-NEC reports nonemployee compensation of $2,000 or more. The threshold was $600 before.
The form goes to the contractor and to the IRS by Monday 1 February 2027, since 31 January 2027 is a Sunday.
Collect a Form W-9 from each US contractor now. It goes to you, not to the IRS.

pieces.title: TEST Why a Delaware franchise tax bill can look huge

slides.title: Why your Delaware franchise tax bill can look huge
The bill starts from authorized shares
slides.body: Delaware's bill is based on authorized shares, and a startup can have millions of them.

slides.title: There is a second method
slides.body: The Assumed Par Value Capital method has a $400 minimum and uses your issued shares and total gross assets.

slides.title: You may pay the lower
slides.body: Delaware's own page says to use the method that results in the lesser tax. The report is due by 1 March.

slides.title: Filing your Delaware report this year?
slides.body: Follow for more founder finance, explained simply.
